rationale: The assistant correctly diagnosed biofilm and mould build-up and guided the customer through cleaning the seal, filter and drawer, running a hot soda crystal cycle, leaving the door open and cutting back on softener. No part was recommended and the 'drum clean' light was explained sensibly. Weaknesses: it never asked about wash temperatures, and it only advised cutting softener at the end. Drawer and hot-cycle steps were repeated across turns. The advice to unscrew the filter after switching off at the wall is acceptable, though it did not say to unplug, and the 90°C cycle could have used a Drum Clean programme suggestion.
